name: Chidi Eze
headline: Developer advocate. Tutorials that work on the first try, and a community that answers its own questions.
summary: Five years in developer relations after three as a backend developer. I write docs and sample apps, run meetups across West Africa, and turn forum complaints into issues engineers can fix. Right now I want contract or freelance work, two or three clients at most, ideally devtools and AI infrastructure companies.

deal_breakers: Contract or freelance only for now; I'm not looking for a full-time job.
No crypto token projects or betting apps.
I won't write content that hides pricing or limits from developers.
nice_to_haves: Budget for community events in Lagos, Accra and Nairobi
Access to the engineers who own the API

open_to.notes: Conference talks and workshops on developer experience. Travel and a fee, or travel for community events.

projects.title: Payments API quickstart rewrite
projects.summary: Rewrote the quickstart and 12 core guides for an African payments API, with runnable samples in Node.js and a sandbox that works without a business account.
projects.outcome: Time to first successful test payment dropped from 47 minutes to 9; docs-related support tickets down 38%.

projects.title: Lagos Builders meetup
projects.summary: Monthly meetup and quarterly hack day, later run in Accra and Nairobi with local co-hosts, sponsored by devtools companies.
projects.outcome: Grew from 30 to 2,800 members; 41 events so far; four sponsors renewed for a second year.

projects.title: LLM sample apps for a vector database company
projects.summary: Six end-to-end sample apps (chat over docs, semantic search, support triage) in TypeScript and Python, each with a written tutorial and a one-click deploy.
projects.outcome: The samples became the top source of trial signups from docs, about 1,900 in the first quarter.

experience.title: Developer advocate and technical writer
experience.summary: Docs, sample apps and community programmes for four devtools and fintech clients.

experience.title: Developer advocate
experience.summary: First DevRel hire. Docs, SDK feedback, hackathons across Nigeria and Ghana.

experience.title: Backend developer
experience.summary: Node.js and Postgres services. Wrote the internal API docs nobody else wanted to.

faq.a: Not right now. I want two or three ongoing clients and time for the meetup. Part-time with a clear scope also works.
USD 70,000 to 90,000 a year equivalent for a half-time retainer, or a fixed price per project. I publish it so we don't waste each other's time.
Yes, from Lagos, UTC+1. I'll travel for conferences and events.
Yes. Every sample app I publish I wrote and maintain. I'm not shipping your production backend though.

faq.q: Do you do AI or LLM content?
faq.a: Yes, for the last year mostly. Retrieval, chat over docs, simple agents. I'm careful to show where they break.
No on-call. I'll watch the community forum, not the pager.
Time to first success, activation from docs, and questions answered by the community instead of support. Not follower counts.

references.name: Folake Adeyemi
references.quote: Our docs went from our biggest support cost to the thing developers mention when they recommend us.

agent_policy.notes: Full-time roles fail my employment check. If you think I should make an exception, send it as a maybe with a reason. This is a fictional example profile for the human.json site; the person, companies and quotes are made up.
